answer: The orchard I would price into every new account is Honey extractor honey jar assay sealed by the apiary register: each honey jar is a brood record countersigned by the inspector, so a farm must spin a hundred real honey frames by hand, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the gale for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The knoll is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
